title: RETRACTION: In the Shadow of Man: Behavioral Changes in Japanese Pika (Ochotona hyperborea yesoensis) Due to Human Presence at Mount Highashi‐Nupukaushi‐Nupuri, Hokkaido, Japan
content:
RETRACTION: F. Chaudhary, T. Watanabe, and R. U. Haq, “ In the Shadow of Man: Behavioral Changes in Japanese Pika (Ochotona hyperborea yesoensis) Due to Human Presence at Mount Highashi-Nupukaushi-Nupuri, Hokkaido, Japan,” Ethology 131, no. 6 (2025): e13562, https://doi.org/10.1111/eth.13562.

The above article, published online on 13 March 2025 in Wiley Online Library (wileyonlinelibrary.com), has been retracted by agreement between the journal Editor-in-Chief, Wolfgang Goymann; and Wiley-VCH GmbH. The retraction has been agreed upon following an investigation which identified several references cited within the article that were invalid or could not be verified. The authors acknowledged that multiple referencing errors had been made and proposed corrections, including the removal and replacement of affected references. However, due to the extent and nature of these errors, the Editors have lost faith in the article and therefore decided a retraction is appropriate. The authors disagree with the retraction.
